title: Practical lamps should make pools, not a flat warm wash
summary: Fill lights + warm lining + warm lamps made the tunnel flat orange. Weak fill, desaturated surfaces, lamps with decay 2 and ~3.5 m range, whiter bulbs: pools of light.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Interiors lit by bulbs, lanterns, pendants.
doc.avoid: Warm everything: warm surfaces x warm lights x warm fill = mono-orange.

problem.symptom: A gallery/room is evenly orange, with no light pools or falloff.
problem.cause: Strong fills and warm-on-warm colours; long-range lights with low decay.
problem.fix: Weak fill, desaturated albedo, decay 2, short range, whiter bulb colour.
problem.detect: Region means nearly equal across lit and unlit regions.
